headline: OpenAI is rolling out GPT-6 across ChatGPT, with paying users first and free users today.
score_reason: Pool score 8 kept: a major model rollout to ChatGPT users, stated in OpenAI's launch and reported by Engadget.
importance_line: Everyday ChatGPT users get a model whose answers can include charts, forms and tappable tools, but the honest doubt is that the article repeats OpenAI's description of these features and did not test them.
summary: Engadget reports that OpenAI has started rolling out GPT-6 to paying ChatGPT users, with a feature called Intelligent UI that lets replies include charts, forms and tappable buttons. Free and low-cost Go users are due to get the model today, but on GPT-6 Luna, a less capable version than the Sol model that paying users receive.
